Nurturing the next generation of physicists in industry, education, and academia.
Come join one of our programs; Undergraduate, Masters, and PhD
Message from the Chair
"Come join us! We have stimulating programs at the undergraduate, Masters, and PhD level. We strive for a vibrant, supportive, inclusive, and friendly environment, where we emphasize close and active interactions amongst students and faculty, with research-informed pedagogy and rich research experiences. The expertise of our world-class faculty range from atomic and molecular physics, quantum sensing, fluid dynamics and ultrafast processes, computational materials science, theoretical chemical physics, and research-informed pedagogy. We love doing research with students, both undergraduates and graduates -- join us, and you will be exposed to the forefront of developments in physics in academia, education, and industry!."
